items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: old man Robichaux was standing outside listening at me play and that's how I got the job.

ctx.x: Different little bands and things. You see, because I didn't go to the Lyric Theater until I left the Cadillac Cabaret.
Where, you see it says worked occasionally with John Robichaux. Where would that have been?
That was at the Lyric Theater.
